newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares up at noon, institutions buy.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares up at noon, institutions buy.

text.p: Shanghai B shares were up solidly at midday on Friday with institutions buying companies which have a heavy weighting on the index, including Shanghai Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone Development Co, brokers said.
The B index rose 1.257 points or 1.45 percent to 88.215 points on volume of 13.2 million shares worth $8.7 million.
Brokers said institutions bought on an expectation of further gains in the B share market and to help further boost market sentiment.

"Some institutions which are holding big positions bought large firms to further boost market sentiment," one broker said. "But follow-up buying was not active because several firms posted poor 1996 results on Thursday."
"Potential for further rises in the afternoon session will be limited with a cautious mood prevalent ahead of the weekend," a second broker said.
Of 43 B shares, 38 traded on Friday monring, with 16 up, three flat and 19 down. Shanghai Hero Co was the star performer, jumping $0.040 or 7.84 percent to $0.550 on volume of 271,100 shares.
Shanghai Lujiazui was the most actively traded stock, rising $0.086 or 6.82 percent to $1.346 on volume of 2.0 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index was down slightly on a technical correction, but trading was very active with investors holding differing views over the short-term market trend, brokers said.
It dipped 3.762 points or 0.26 percent to 1,440.135 on volume of 421.5 million shares worth 6.3 billion yuan.
The SSE 30 blue chip index rose 28.010 points or 0.74 percent to 3,820.207. SAIC Multiple Trading was the biggest loser, falling 0.84 yuan or 6.80 percent to 11.51.
